title: 面向投资者微博的语义增强观点感知情感分析方法
summary: 针对金融情感分析中缺乏对情感目标细粒度理解的问题，本文通过为StockEmotions数据集添加语义结构化的观点图来增强情感分析。利用声明式LLM流水线，从StockTwits评论中提取观点图，并结合图神经网络（GNN）进行情感分类。实验表明，引入观点语义能提升不同情感谱系的分类性能。
summary_en: To address the lack of fine-grained understanding of sentiment targets in financial NLP, this paper augments the StockEmotions dataset with semantically structured opinion graphs. Using a declarative LLM pipeline, it extracts opinion graphs from StockTwits comments and applies GNNs for classification, showing improved performance across emotional spectrums.
